hyde_passage: Hematopoietic stem cell division involves complex mechanisms of asymmetric and symmetric segregation to maintain the blood system. hyde_passage_raw:
The claim that all hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) segregate their chromosomes randomly is incorrect. While many stem cells undergo symmetric or asymmetric division with stochastic chromosome distribution, research into hematopoietic stem cell dynamics has identified mechanisms that can lead to non-random segregation.
